title: wss: rate limit MUST rate-limit contradicts SHOULD be delivered
description: ChatTypingEvent section says 'Servers MUST rate-limit outbound typing events per sender per chat: no more than one ChatTypingEvent per sender per chat per 3 seconds SHOULD be delivered.' Opening with MUST but qualifying the specific rate with SHOULD creates an internal contradiction — what exactly is mandatory? Decision: either 'Servers MUST rate-limit...MUST deliver no more than one per 3 seconds' (hard limit) or 'Servers SHOULD rate-limit...no more than one per 3 seconds' (best practice). Same issue applies to ChatPresenceEvent rate limit.
close_reason: Downgraded typing rate limit from MUST to SHOULD throughout (section and security considerations), matching presence section. Presence was already consistently SHOULD.
